title: Route local-vs-cloud placement by task class and budget
goal: InferenceRouter::plan_placement_for chooses local vs cloud by policy only; the brain's task class and SUSI_BUDGET do not reach it. Feed the classified task class and budget into placement (reflex stays local, reasoning may escalate unless privacy/budget forbids) without weakening the privacy gate. Add tests named placement_uses_task_class_*.
